name: Card header
purpose: Shows at a glance how something on a card stands, when it needs attention: the top of the card in a colour for its state, holding its title, such as Disqualified, Revoked or Expired.

proposed.design: a screenshot of the future driving designs in Figma, shared by Shaun in November 2026, until there’s a link to the file

origin.notes: From the future driving designs in Figma, which we have only as a screenshot for now, so its sizes are approximate. Today the app shows an expired licence on its ordinary card, and a disqualified, revoked or surrendered one with a screen of its own, DrivingLicenceNoticeView. The colours are GovKit's: yellowTint80, yellowTint50 and accentRed.

tone.description: caution: pale yellow, as for an expired licence. warning: yellow, as for a revoked one. danger: red, as for a disqualified driver.

tall.description: Makes it at least 120pt tall, its content at the bottom, as the designs show a state that is the card's whole point, such as Disqualified.

inputs.content: What it holds, such as a heading, or a line of text over one, 8pt apart.

rules: Use it only for a state that needs the user's attention, such as an expired, revoked or disqualified licence. A card that's fine has no header.
Put the state in words in its title: the colour alone doesn't tell everyone.
Match the tone to how serious the state is: caution for something to put right, warning for something that stops the user, danger for the most serious.
Put it in a grouped list's first row, flush, so it fills the top of the card, and say what the state means, and what to do, in the rows below.

ios.symbol: DrivingLicenceNoticeView, how the app shows these states today

examples.name: Danger, tall, as a disqualified driver
examples.html:
<govuk-app-grouped-list>
  <govuk-app-grouped-list-row type="content" flush>
    <govuk-app-card-header tone="danger" tall>
      <govuk-app-heading level="2" size="title-1">Disqualified</govuk-app-heading>
    </govuk-app-card-header>
  </govuk-app-grouped-list-row>
  <govuk-app-grouped-list-row type="content">
    <govuk-app-text>You have been disqualified from driving until 24 April 2026.</govuk-app-text>
  </govuk-app-grouped-list-row>
</govuk-app-grouped-list>

examples.name: Warning, tall, as a revoked licence
